summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4_qsa stores QSA main K/V as B12X NVFP4 records
compatibility: No user action required. FP8 remains the default; nvfp4_qsa is an explicit option.
details: Each token, KV head and side stores a 148-byte NVFP4 record (E2M1 values, E4M3 scales per 16 values, fp32 per-row outer scale) instead of 256 FP8 bytes. The QSA selector cache stays BF16.
The B12X QSA plan owns the NVFP4 writer; attention reads records bitwise-identically to BF16 attention over the decoded values.
KVQuantMode.NVFP4_QSA keeps the generic nvfp4 page geometry and FlashInfer paths from applying to these pages.
